## Plain-Language Explanation for Clinicians
The multimodal model analyzed the patient's chest X-ray alongside their clinical profile (60-year-old female presenting with fever and cough). The system identified strong radiologic indicators consistent with **Pneumonia**, classifying the image with 100% confidence. 

The adaptive gating mechanism heavily favored the visual imaging features over the clinical data for this case. Clinicians should inspect the Grad-CAM heatmap at `outputs\gradcam_result.png` to review the specific lung regions that triggered this high-confidence pneumonia classification.
